r18/app_data_table.reason: [ref-callback-rerun] the inline callback ref that sets el.indeterminate = some runs once; React re-runs it on every render, so the select-all box never becomes indeterminate

r18/app_tabs_accordion.reason: [list-row-conditional] accordion rows inside the conditionally mounted FAQ panel keep {isOpen && <p/>} from mount: the previous answer stays open after toggling another row

r18/class_pure_component.reason: [render-count] PureComponent render is logged once less: Krate updates the text binding without re-running render(); DOM and state match

r18/context_memo_child.reason: [render-count] the context value is now plain and the text updates, but the memo child's body (its render log) does not re-run on context changes

r18/diag_string_ref.reason: [missing-diagnostic] string ref (ref="name", this.refs): build succeeds with no KR5xxx diagnostic

r18/effect_reads_ref.reason: [autofocus] input focused from an effect gets its controlled/default value written after focus, so the caret is at the start and typing prepends (!draft)

r18/event_double_click.reason: [autofocus] autoFocus is emitted as an attribute and the controlled value is set after focus, so typing lands at the start (' docUntitled')

r18/form_controlled_checkbox.reason: [controlled-revert] a checkbox with checked={true} and an onChange that does not set state unchecks on click; React reverts it to checked

r18/form_controlled_reject.reason: [controlled-input] rejected edits are now restored, except an input with a constant value and a no-op onChange: typing still changes the DOM value (xread only by state)

r18/hook_usecallback_identity.reason: [render-count] render counters kept in refs differ because Krate does not re-run component bodies; handlers and logs match

r18/hook_useid.reason: [id-format] useId strings differ (krate-1-Field-Field_c0 vs _r_0_); ids are unique and label/aria links work on both sides

r18/hook_useref_mutable.reason: [ref-in-render] ref.current read during render is shown once and never refreshed on later renders; no diagnostic for the unsupported pattern

r18/hook_usestate_lazy_init.reason: [caret] the lazy initializer runs once and the value matches, but the controlled textarea value is written after hydration, so the caret starts at the end and typing appends (React: caret at the start)

r18/ref_callback_inline_rerender.reason: [callback-ref] inline callback refs are never called (no node on mount, no null/node pair on re-render)

r18/ref_callback_mount_unmount.reason: [callback-ref] a useCallback ref on a conditional element is never called (not with the node on mount or remount, not with null on unmount)

r18/suspense_fallback_then_content.reason: [suspense-lazy] build fails: lazy(() => promise) is evaluated at build time ('cannot evaluate delay(...)')

r18/suspense_lazy.reason: [suspense-lazy] build fails: lazy(() => import('...')) is rejected ('DynamicImport expressions are not supported')

r18/suspense_lazy_on_click.reason: [suspense-lazy] build fails: lazy(() => import('...')) is rejected ('DynamicImport expressions are not supported')

r18/suspense_nested.reason: [suspense-lazy] build fails: nested Suspense with lazy(() => promise) evaluated at build time

r19/action_form_auto_reset.reason: [form-actions] the action, message and auto-reset match; with the fixture's 80ms delay Krate commits the result one frame after React, so the snapshot right after the click can still show the old field value

r19/action_server_direct.reason: [async-transition] direct server action call works end to end, but useTransition isPending stays false during the async transition ('loading' never shows)

r19/app_reference.reason: [use-promise] the reference app builds and its actions, useFormStatus and useOptimistic run; use(promise) under Suspense shows the list immediately instead of the 'loading todos' fallback, which shifts the later steps

r19/deferred_initial_value.reason: [deferred-value] build fails: useDeferredValue(value, initialValue) result passed to a memo child cannot be evaluated at build time

r19/meta_tags_hoist.reason: [derived-render-values] <title>/<meta>/<link> are hoisted into <head> and match after load, but the component's local derived from a prop (const p = posts[props.index]) is evaluated once, so the head and the article do not update on 'next post'

r19/ref_callback_cleanup.reason: [callback-ref] a ref callback that returns a cleanup is never called: no attach on mount, no cleanup on detach

r19/transition_async.reason: [async-transition] useTransition isPending stays false during an async transition; the final tab matches

r19/use_promise_suspense.reason: [use-promise] use(promise) under Suspense: no fallback, the list renders empty and never fills, switching posts does not suspend
